description: nhentai.net gallery page as the DOM after its JavaScript ran (Playwright fallback path: page.content()). Same #info / section#tags / .tag-container engine as nhentai-gallery, but: the cover and the first six thumbnails have been swapped by the lazyload-image element (class lazyloaded, src = data-src, .webp); the rest still carry the 1x1 GIF placeholder; time[datetime] text has been rewritten to relative ("2 years, 6 months ago"), so the concrete date is only in the datetime/title attributes; the empty Characters and Groups rows are present but carry class "hidden" and an empty span.tags; the pretty title itself contains " | " (romaji | English), which must not be mistaken for a "Title | Site" separator; the bracketed tail holds a magazine "(COMIC PenDpol 2024-03)" that is NOT a parody and a scanlator "[Quill Mapj]" that is NOT a group; category is "manga" and parody is "original". Noise: nav, injected ExoClick-style ad iframes, "More Like This" with five galleries (one by the same artist, others by other artists, all with their own covers), and client-rendered comments whose bodies contain a fake "Tags: netorare, ahegao" row label and an "Artist: Quill Olfx" label, plus comment time[datetime] elements later than the upload. Unsure: nhentai's exact relative-time wording, the comment markup (I reconstructed it from the comment API fields), and whether 2024 uploads use .webp covers (I believe the API's "t":"w" type is real).
